evaluation_policy.primary_matching: One-to-one semantic matching. A predicted row matches one gold requirement when it preserves the actor, action, material condition, timing, and threshold; wording need not match exactly. A prediction may cover several gold requirements only if it explicitly preserves each distinct obligation. Do not give multiple predictions credit for the same gold requirement.
evaluation_policy.recall: matched gold requirements / 47 core gold requirements
evaluation_policy.precision: supported predicted obligation rows / all predicted obligation rows
scoring_notes: Score eligibility_conditions separately because they are rejection grounds or eligibility risks, not instructions to perform an action.
Do not include contextual_clauses in the primary denominator; they preserve relevant form fields and contract rules whose wording does not clearly create a distinct bidder or contractor obligation.

Score unit_price_items separately if item-level technical or pricing coverage is desired. The primary set contains the obligation to price and perform the table; it does not count each table row as an additional matrix obligation.
Do not count headings, table-of-contents entries, website listings, government-only actions, or negative controls as positive obligations.
A row about an incorporated external document is supported only to the extent stated in this PDF. Do not score unseen details of that document as established facts.
Treat duplicate predictions for one gold obligation as extra predicted rows when calculating precision.
The facsimile-submission rule has conflicting cover-page text. Credit a prediction that records the SI09 prohibition and flags the conflict; do not require an unsupported resolution.

negative_controls.false_claim: Security clearance, security screening, or security-access approval is required for this project.
negative_controls.actual_source: SC01 says the project contains no security requirement; this is distinct from BA07 bid security and GC9 financial contract security.

negative_controls.false_claim: A mandatory site visit must be attended.
negative_controls.actual_source: SI03 says there will be no site visit.

negative_controls.false_claim: The bidder must submit enquiries at least seven days before closing.
negative_controls.actual_source: SI02 says enquiries should arrive by then to allow a response; late enquiries may go unanswered. Asking a question is optional.

negative_controls.false_claim: An initial bid can definitely be faxed because the cover lists a fax number.
negative_controls.actual_source: SI09 expressly rejects fax/email bids, while the cover labels a fax number for bids; this is a conflict to flag, not resolve by assumption. SI04 separately permits fax revisions.

negative_controls.false_claim: The bidder must provide performance and labour/material payment bonds in the forms listed on SI10.
negative_controls.actual_source: SI10 lists website links for forms, but this PDF does not establish that those bonds are required. BA07 separately requires bid security.

negative_controls.false_claim: The bidder must provide Canada 10 days for representations before bid rejection.
negative_controls.actual_source: SI12(2) assigns that notice and opportunity to Canada; it is not a bidder obligation.

negative_controls.false_claim: The bidder must reduce its bid price by up to 15% if funding is insufficient.
negative_controls.actual_source: SI06 says Canada may negotiate such a reduction with the lowest compliant bidder; it does not force acceptance.

negative_controls.false_claim: Every hyperlink or table-of-contents heading creates a separate bidder obligation or proves an external file is missing.
negative_controls.actual_source: SI10 is a website list; SI, SC, BA, and Appendix 1 clauses occur within this same PDF.

known_issues.description: The cover says FAX pour soumissions, SI04 allows facsimile bid revisions, and SI09 states facsimile or email bids are not accepted. Treat initial bid fax submission as unresolved while preserving SI09's explicit prohibition.
BA03 is the offer amount field, while the unit-price table instructs transfer of the total estimated amount to SA03. Do not silently rewrite the printed reference.
R2710T, several General Conditions, wage schedules, IBC Form 2100, drawings, and specifications are incorporated by reference but their complete texts are not in this PDF.
